definition: The rate of decay per undecayed nucleus of a nuclide, $\lambda = A/N$, in $\text{s}^{-1}$; it is close to the probability that a nucleus decays in unit time only when $\lambda t$ is small.
The rule that the number of undecayed nuclei falls exponentially with time, $N = N_0\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda t}$, so the activity $A = \lambda N$ falls in the same way.
